note: LiTime onboarding research drafts (2026-11-25). Store: www.litime.com is Shopify (products.json and /cart/*.js work); US store, ships to the continental US only. Awin default link https://www.awin1.com/cread.php?awinmid=71451&awinaffid=3120687 (one curl -sIL) 302s to https://www.litime.com?sv1=affiliate&sv_campaign_id=3120687&source=aw&awc=71451_… and ends 200 on www.litime.com, so it lands on the US store. Facts from LiTime's own product pages (spec tables, FAQs), Black Friday page, warranty and refund policy pages, fetched with curl 2026-11-25; no independent test of these exact models was found, so caveats rely on LiTime's own statements. Codes: Awin code TOPKF10 (10% off) works on all five picks and stacks with LiTime's automatic Black Friday product discounts, but on the 48V pack it replaces the automatic 'Spend $799, get 6% off' tier instead of stacking. LiTime prints no public promo code on litime.com: the Black Friday sale (Nov. 19–30) is automatic ('no code needed'), and the only other code offers are a 6% sign-up discount for new members and LiPoints redemption, both tied to an account and not tested. Picks follow DLC-340 and the gap pages that already list LiTime rows (12V 100Ah Group 24 Bluetooth, LiHeat Group 24, the Group 31 trolling/classic 12V 100Ah, and the 48V 100Ah golf cart battery). The older non-Xtra '12V 100Ah Mini' is not in litime.com's products.json today; the Xtra-Mini (Group 22NF) is LiTime's current mini 12V 100Ah and is picked in its place. LiTime's Group 31 slot uses the Classic 12V 100Ah (LiTime's 'Best-Selling Classic', Group 31 size, 286 reviews); the 12V 100Ah TM Group 31 (same $335.99 list) is a near twin not picked. Category: all five fit the existing 'lithium-battery' key. Prices are cart totals for 1 unit before any code, after automatic discounts; list_price is LiTime's strike-through on its Black Friday page or product page. Cart tests in growth/focus/offers/data/litime-2026-11-25-carttests.jsonl.

records.summary: LiTime's smallest 12V 100Ah battery: 1,280 Wh in a Group 22NF case that weighs 19.13 lb, with a 100 A BMS, Bluetooth monitoring and a low-temperature charging cutoff. LiTime says it can be mounted upright, on its side or on its end.
records.fit: Suits truck beds, kayaks, small trolling-motor boats, mobility scooters and van builds where a Group 24 case does not fit or weight matters. records.summary: A single 51.2V 100Ah LiFePO4 pack (5.12 kWh) that replaces eight 6V or six 8V lead-acid golf cart batteries, with 100 A continuous output, 600 A for one second and Bluetooth monitoring. It was $799.00 in LiTime's cart on 2026-11-25 after the store's automatic Black Friday and spend-tier discounts, without a charger.
records.fit: Suits owners of stock 48 V Club Car, EZGO, ICON or Yamaha carts on mostly flat courses and neighborhoods who already have, or will buy, a 58.4 V lithium charger. Carts that draw more than 100 A for long stretches (lifted carts, large tires, steep hills) are better served by a 200 A continuous pack such as Vatrer's 48V 105Ah Club Car kit ($1,499.99 with charger at Vatrer, checked 2026-11-21); the Redodo 48V 100Ah battery is a near match at $836.99 (Redodo store, checked 2026-11-21).

LiTime's spec table lists a 57.6 V ± 0.8 V charge voltage, while its FAQ recommends 53.25–54.75 V; check the charger setting against the manual.
